# SML Page Builder Registry — schema 3.0 (`sml-page-builder-registry/`)

## Selection — `sml-page-builder-registry/data/selection.md` (generated by `registry-build`)
Markdown with one ```json block:
- `registry` = `sml-page-builder-registry`, `schema` = `3.0`, `digest` (12 hex of the component list; confirm it in write results), `generated{at, skillVersion, mcpVersion}`, `site{id,name}`, `counts{section,item}`, `legend`, `duplicateNames[]`, `nearMissNames[]`
- `components[]`: `name` (verbatim), `id`, `kind` (`section`|`item`), `content[]`, `capacity{X:{max, shownByDefault?}}`, `slots[]`,
  `cms` (`{status:"estimated", min, basis}` from CMS-bound props, or `{status:"unknown", basis}`), `options[]`, `toggles[]`,
  `warnings[]` (`ambiguous-slots`, `fixed-count`, `count-switch`, `cms-content`, `no-writable-content`), `props` (count)
After writing, `registry-verify --readback <stored selection result> --expected out/selection.json` recomputes the digest from the stored components; a digest string match alone is not proof.
Derived only from one `get_all_components{includeProps}` call.

## Knowledge — `sml-page-builder-registry/data/knowledge.md` (curated, written by `knowledge-build`)
`registry`, `kind:"knowledge"`, `schema:"1.0"`, `updated`, `site{id}`, `starter{pageId,title,validatedAt,heroComponent?,elements{wrapper,hero,navigation,footer,prefilled[{name,id}]?}}` (from `starter-check`),
`locales{primary{tag,subdirectory},secondary[]}`, `links{href:{path,pageId,resolution:exact|locale-stripped|normalized|confirmed|manual,note?}}`,
`components{id:{name,visual,visualBasis?,bestFor[],notFor[],limits[],cms{status:verified|estimated|unknown,count?,basis},execDeps[],configs[]?,sig}}`, `catalogue{pageId,path:"/stylesheet/components",publicUrl,readVia}?`
- `visualBasis`: where `visual` came from (`catalogue`, `fields+defaults` when the catalogue is unavailable, `designer`). Anything other than `catalogue`/`designer` is provisional., `notes[]`.
- Selection (registry) is authoritative for fields, capacity, toggles and warnings; knowledge is authoritative for purpose
  (`visual`, `bestFor`, `notFor`), curated `limits` and CMS evidence.
- `sig` = 10-hex fingerprint of the component's registry entry (name, content, capacity, slots, options, toggles, warnings),
  stamped by `knowledge-build --selection` when missing or for `--reviewed` ids. `select-context` reports a mismatch as
  `knowledgeStale`; entries whose component left the registry are `obsolete` and rejected by `knowledge-build`.
- Similar-page link matches (`review`) are stored only after confirmation (`confirmed`, with a note).
A refresh never rewrites knowledge.

## Selection cards — `select-context` (local, not stored)
Per component: registry facts + knowledge purpose + `knowledgeStale`; `health{noVisual[],stale[],obsolete[],renamed[]}`.
About 27 KB for 40 components; read it instead of re-reading the catalogue.

## Legacy — `sml-marketer-registry/` (schema 2.x)
Readable as-is (`cmsLists` → `cms` estimated/unknown). `registry-build` migrates on refresh: creates the new files, then `cleanup.call.json` deletes the legacy root (cascades).

## Execution details — local `execution.json` (not stored in Webflow)
`schema`, `kind:"execution"`, `problems[]`, `deps[]`, `components{id:{name, kind, variants[], props[], slots[]?, slotNamesUnique?, instanceSlotNames?, duplicateKeys?}}`
- per component also `writable{text, link, unsupported[types]}`; prop: `id`, `key`, `group`, `name`, `type`, `default` (non-text), `defaultText` (text, first 80 chars; for leftover checks), `write{type, field, note?}` or `write:null` + `writeNote`; variant: `options[{id,name}]` + `optionsFrom{component, method}` when resolved, else `optionsLazy:true`.

## Caching of execution details (not implemented)
Execution details depend on component definitions. MCP 2.2 exposes no component version or modified timestamp
(`get_all_components`, `get_component` and localization `list_components` return none), so a stored copy cannot be
reliably invalidated. v0.4.0 instead fetches only what a build writes (lazy variant resolution) and prefetches known
nested dependencies (`execDeps`), which is self-correcting: missing ones are requested by `exec-needs`.

## Section status — `writes-build` (local, not stored)
`supported` (all writes valid, no visible defaults) · `limited` (suitable; accepted gaps with reasons or declared `limits`) ·
`unsuitable` (visible defaults remain — blocking) · `invalid` (bad writes — blocking) · `unresolved` (no component — blocking; ask the user) ·
`skipped` (left out by explicit decision) · `removed` (prefilled Starter section removed from the new page).
`--plan` runs the same checks before any Webflow change and never writes a call.

## Configs (knowledge, v0.7)
`configs[{prop:"Group.Name", type, values:{<value as JSON text, e.g. "true">:{label?, shows?:{<repeat base>:N}}},
status:confirmed|inferred, basis:designer-render|live-render|site-owner|catalogue|definition-tree, evidence, checkedAt}]`.
`confirmed` requires designer-render, live-render or site-owner. `writes-build`/`verify-page --knowledge` treat repeats beyond
`shows` as hidden for the chosen value; `select-context` marks a `count-switch` warning RESOLVED when a confirmed config exists,
otherwise adds `investigate`. One shared rule (`config_check`) for select-context, compose, writes-build and verify-page: configs are usable only when the knowledge `sig` equals the fingerprint of the component's current registry entry. Stale, unsigned, or unverifiable (no registry passed: give writes-build/verify-page `--selection`) configs are not used, hide no repeats, resolve no warnings, and are reported under `reinvestigate`.

## Execution additions (v0.7)
With the component's definition tree (`exec-needs --investigate`): `repeatVisibility{<base>:{"1":"always"|"conditional"|"prop:<id>"|"hidden"}}`
(a repeat takes the weakest condition among its bound elements) and `configHint` naming the likely governing setting.

## Local helpers (not stored)
`catalogue --pages` finds the SML catalogue page; `catalogue --tree` lists demonstrated components and their non-text settings.
`compose --spec --selection [--knowledge]` reports the section sequence, runs of 3+ identical components, and repeat layouts
that could carry each structured section (`shape{items,purpose}`), filtered by knowledge `notFor`. Advisory only.
It also offers **purpose layouts** (`fit:"purpose layout"`, `basis:"knowledge bestFor"`): components whose knowledge `bestFor`
includes the item's purpose, image layouts included (`placeholderImage:true` = the image stays a placeholder; not a penalty).

## Images and media (v0.7.3)
- Image props are never written and never count against fit or status. `writes-build` and `verify-page` list each visible
  default image under `productionReview` ("placeholder image kept — replace in the Designer before publishing").
- Media props (type video, or a text prop named video/embed/iframe, or a default that is a video URL) with a non-empty
  default are checked against their on-switches (booleans named video/lightbox/embed in the same group): all off →
  `productionReview` note; on, or no switch → blocking leftover (write, switch off, or `accept` with a reason → limited).

## v1.0.0 additions
- **Visibility gates** (`exec-build` with a definition tree): `visibleIf {contentPropId: [booleanPropId]}` and the readable
  `visibilityControls {"Group.Name": ["Group.Name", …]}` — booleans whose direct Visibility binding (sourceType `prop`)
  sits on the path to *every* element bound to the content prop, in any group. Conditional rules and nested instances
  with more than one Visibility prop are ignored (ambiguous). Leftover and production-review checks honour them.
- **Knowledge visibility config**: `{"kind":"visibility","prop","hides":[keys],"status":"confirmed","basis":
  "definition-tree|designer-render|live-render|site-owner","evidence","checkedAt"}`; used only under `config_check`.
- **Spec**: link `{"unlinked":"<action>"}`, link `{"href",…,"action":"<action>"}`, item `actions` and `unplacedActions`.
- **writes-build** output `links {linked[{where,action?,to,mode,pageId?}], unlinked[{where,action}], unplaced[{section,action}],
  internalMethod}`; `--native-links` writes internal links as `link_mode:"page"` + pageId.
- **verify-page**: page-mode links checked by pageId; `unlinked` lists verified visible buttons without destination.
